answer: Decay-on-dormancy tenure resists sybils: earning and voting weight accrues only through continuously maintained active tenure and decays toward zero during any gap, so standing must be sustained, not minted. Freshly spawned fakes start at zero and must each stay genuinely active every epoch up a long ledge of ramp; lapse and accrued standing corrodes like ferrous metal left in rain. A burst of mass creation yields no influence — there is no quick nectar of reputation — since weight tracks uninterrupted presence, forcing an attacker to keep every fake live and working across the window.
